_note: Background timelines are fixed history; 2026 events come from the 12-13 Oct 2026 reference editions (The Hindu, TOI/Reuters/AFP, CNN). The live part of the war page comes from today's news. Add or fix events with `digest war add-event`.

wars.name: Russia-Ukraine war
timeline: Feb-Mar 2014: Russia annexes Crimea and backs rebels in eastern Ukraine (Donbas)
24 Feb 2022: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine
Sep-Nov 2022: Ukraine takes back land in Kharkiv and Kherson; Russia claims four regions
2023: Ukraine's counteroffensive makes only small gains
Aug 2024: Ukraine pushes into Russia's Kursk region
2026: Ukraine hits Russian refineries; Iran war pushes up fuel prices
Early Oct 2026: Trump announces an energy ceasefire; Kyiv says it learned of it from the media
12 Oct 2026: Kremlin rejects Zelensky's 60-day truce plan for elections; strikes continue
india: Oil prices: the war and sanctions change the price India pays for fuel.
Russian oil: India has bought large amounts of Russian crude since 2022, so US-Russia deals matter.
Diplomacy: India calls for dialogue and peace and talks to both sides.

wars.name: Israel-Hamas (Gaza) war
timeline: 7 Oct 2023: Hamas attacks southern Israel; about 1,200 killed and about 250 taken hostage
Oct 2023: Israel starts air strikes and then a ground operation in Gaza
Nov 2023: A week-long truce lets some hostages and prisoners be exchanged
May 2024: Israel launches an operation in Rafah in southern Gaza
Jan 2025: A ceasefire and hostage-release deal begins
Mar 2025: Israel restarts strikes after the ceasefire breaks down
Oct 2025: A new US-backed ceasefire plan starts
india: West Asia: India has close ties with both Israel and Arab states, and millions of Indians work in the Gulf.
India's stand: India supports a two-state solution and has sent humanitarian aid to Gaza.

wars.name: Iran war (Israel/US-Iran conflict)
timeline: Jun 2025: Israel and the US strike Iran's nuclear sites; a ceasefire ends the '12-day war'
28 Feb 2026: US and Israel attack Iran; Supreme Leader Khamenei killed
Early war: a strike on a primary school in Minab kills 160+ girls (The Hindu)
Mar 2026: reports say Russia gave Iran targeting information
Spring 2026: global fuel crisis; rupee under pressure; RBI steps in
Jul 2026: Houthi-Saudi truce collapses, opening a Yemen front
Jul-Sep 2026: Indian crude basket climbs from $82.04 to $116.09 a barrel
Sep 2026: suspected Iran-linked plot on the RAF Fairford base in England
india: Fuel and inflation: India imports most of its oil, so the war pushes up prices.
Rupee: costlier crude means more dollars are needed, which weakens the rupee.
Indians abroad: Gulf flights and safety risks affect millions of Indians.

wars.name: Yemen war (Saudi-led coalition vs Houthis)
timeline: Sep 2014: Houthi rebels capture Yemen's capital Sanaa
Mar 2015: Saudi-led coalition starts a war to back Yemen's government
Apr 2022: UN-brokered truce; large-scale fighting falls
Nov 2023: Houthis start attacking Red Sea shipping over the Gaza war
Jan 2026: UAE leaves Yemen under Saudi pressure; southern separatist council (STC) dissolves
13 Jul 2026: Saudi strike hits Sanaa airport runway; Houthis declare the truce over
20 Jul 2026: Houthis declare a sea and air blockade on Saudi Arabia
3-10 Sep 2026: Houthi offensive takes the Red Sea coast and Mocha; oil above $100
5-11 Oct 2026: Saudi counter-push; Houthis hit airports including Riyadh
india: Oil and rupee: India imports most of its oil, so higher prices weaken the rupee.
Indians in the Gulf: millions live and work there; flights to Riyadh were cancelled.
Trade route: the Red Sea carries much of India's trade with Europe.

wars.name: Sudan civil war
timeline: 15 Apr 2023: Fighting breaks out between the Sudanese army (SAF) and the RSF
2023: Fighting spreads to Darfur; millions flee their homes
Aug 2024: Famine is confirmed in the Zamzam camp in Darfur
Mar 2025: The army retakes the presidential palace in Khartoum
Oct 2025: The RSF captures El Fasher, the army's last big base in Darfur
india: Indians abroad: India evacuated about 3,800 people from Sudan in Operation Kaveri (2023).
Africa ties: instability hurts India's trade and energy links in East Africa.

wars.name: Myanmar civil war
timeline: 1 Feb 2021: The military takes power in a coup
2021: The opposition forms a National Unity Government and armed groups
Oct 2023: Ethnic armed groups launch 'Operation 1027' and win big areas
2024: The Arakan Army takes most of Rakhine state near India's Kaladan project
28 Mar 2025: A strong earthquake hits central Myanmar
Dec 2025: The junta holds phased elections
india: Border security: India shares a long border with Myanmar touching four north-eastern states.
Projects: the Kaladan transit project to Mizoram runs through war-hit Rakhine.
Refugees: fighting pushes people into Mizoram and Manipur.

wars.name: DR Congo-M23 conflict
timeline: 2012: M23 rebels first rise in eastern Congo
2021-22: M23 restarts fighting
Jan 2025: M23 captures the city of Goma
Feb 2025: M23 takes Bukavu
Jun 2025: Congo and Rwanda sign a US-brokered peace deal
india: Peacekeeping: Indian soldiers serve in the UN mission in Congo (MONUSCO).
Minerals: Congo has much of the world's cobalt, used in batteries.
